observations: Photo 0 shows a single headlight assembly wrapped in clear plastic film.
The headlight has a black housing with a yellow section at the top.
The lens surface is covered by plastic wrap, obscuring the actual condition of the glass.
A watermark 'HONDA AND ACURA' is visible across the center of the image.
The item is presented as a used part in a plastic-wrapped state.

claims.claim: Body,engine n suspension parts for all model of honda,acura n toyota cars n suvs
claims.evidence: Only one headlight is shown; the seller's claim of multiple parts for multiple brands is not supported by the photo.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The headlight may be non-functional or have a burnt-out bulb.
risks.proof: A photo of the headlight with the bulb removed showing the filament or a video of it powered on.

risks.risk: The plastic wrap may conceal significant cracks, scratches, or internal damage to the lens.
risks.proof: A clear, unwrapped photo of the headlight lens.

risks.risk: The bulb may be missing or the bulb holder may be broken.
risks.proof: A photo of the bulb and its socket.

proof_requests: Photo of the bulb and its socket.
Photo of the headlight without the plastic wrap.
Photo of the bulb with the headlight powered on.
Photo of the bulb with the headlight powered off.
response.reason: The item is a single headlight assembly. It can be priced at its worst-case value as a non-functional, damaged part.
